name: Thai Coconut Green Curry Soup with Tofu, Mixed Veggies & Cilantro
ingredients: 48 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
¼ cup Thai curry paste, green
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and roughly chop bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper along with the broccoli.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add curry paste and veggies; cook, stirring frequently, until veggies start to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Add broth, coconut milk, sugar, and salt to the pot. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
While the soup is heating, medium dice tofu.
Once the soup is simmering, add tofu and reduce heat to medium-low. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender and tofu is warmed through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the soup is done, remove from heat. Add cilantro and vinegar, then stir to combine.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
